source_name: PPAC Installed Refining Capacity
notes: Pre-existing dataset, independently validated before this phase and NOT modified. 24 rows, 267.116 MMTPA total. Authoritative total is cross-checked by data/validation/validate_refineries.py.

source_name: PIB / MoPNG Lok Sabha reply 'Government steps to Strengthen Strategic Petroleum Reserves'
notes: Primary source for Phase I and Phase II capacities. Corroborated by PIB PRID 1739019 (2021), which gives the same per-location split. Raw copy archived at data/raw/pib/.

source_name: ISPRL About Us
notes: CONFLICTS WITH SRC002 on the Phase I total: ISPRL states 5.03 MMT, PIB states 5.33 MMT. The PIB per-location split (1.33 + 1.5 + 2.5) is internally consistent and sums to 5.33, so the dataset follows PIB; the ISPRL figure is preserved in docs/data_sources.md and asserted as a warning by the validator. ISPRL is the sole source for commissioning dates. Raw copy archived at data/raw/isprl/.

source_name: Ministry of Ports Shipping and Waterways Annual Report 2024-25
notes: Primary source for most Major Port profiles, including the crude evidence for Deendayal, Visakhapatnam and Cochin's SPM count.

source_name: MoPNG-PS&W Ports Wing
data_type: count and status of Major Ports
notes: Source of the '14 Major Ports of which 12 are operational' statement, which validate_ports.py asserts as a composition cross-check.

source_name: MoPNG-PS&W monthly cargo handling report (November 2025)
notes: Source of the canonical Major Port names and authority abbreviations, and of the publisher's own POL taxonomy (POL Crude / POL Products / LPG or LNG) which is why 'POL' alone is not treated as evidence of crude handling. NOTE: the filename misspells 'November' as 'Nvember' on the publisher's server; the URL is recorded exactly as it resolves.

source_name: Mumbai Port Authority - Marine Oil Terminals
notes: Sole source of the Jawahar Dweep crude-handling statement for PORT003.

source_name: New Mangalore Port Authority - Brief History
notes: Sole source of the 'POL Crude for MRPL' statement establishing crude handling and refinery connection for PORT006.

source_name: Paradip Port Authority official website
notes: Sole source establishing crude, pipeline, storage and refinery connectivity for PORT012 in a single quoted sentence.

source_name: Gujarat Maritime Board - Greenfield Ports and Captive Jetties
data_type: non-major port and captive jetty descriptions
notes: State-government source for the crude evidence at Mundra (PORT015). The companion captive-jetty register at https://gmbports.org/captive-jetties is the source for Sikka (PORT016), including the 'BORL - SPM Sikka Crude oil' entry.

source_name: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim
notes: COORDINATES ONLY. Used because no official Indian or international publisher gives machine-readable coordinates for these facilities. Every coordinate sourced this way carries coordinate_source / coordinate_source_url in its own row, kept separate from the row's factual source, and a coordinate_precision of 'locality' - these are area centroids, NOT berth or lane positions. An Overpass query for ISPRL facilities returned nothing, which is why strategic_reserves.csv has null coordinates throughout.

source_name: UN Statistics Division Standard Country or Area Codes (M49)
data_type: country names codes and regional groupings
notes: Sole authority for country naming, ISO alpha-3, M49 numeric code, region and subregion. Country names are used exactly as UN M49 publishes them ('Russian Federation', 'United States of America'), never shortened.

source_name: OFAC Sanctions Programs and Country Information
notes: Used ONLY at program level, never at entity level. The SDN and Consolidated lists are deliberately not reproduced in this repository. sanctions_reference_status in suppliers.csv reflects country-based programs only; thematic programs can reach any country, which is recorded as SAN008.

source_name: EIA Background Reference: Iraq
notes: Source of the only four point-valued API/sulfur assays in the dataset (CG001-CG004).

source_name: ADNOC - Murban Crude
notes: Producer's own published specification for Murban (CG005): API 40, sulfur 0.778. A national oil company publishing its own product spec is treated as authoritative for that product.

source_name: EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia
notes: Table 2 publishes the five Arabian grades as RANGES with Saudi Aramco as the underlying data source. Ranges are stored verbatim, never collapsed to a midpoint. Independent arithmetic cross-check: the reserve shares in the same table (35+17+34+13+1) sum to exactly 100%. Also the source of the Yanbu export-terminal statement used by suppliers.csv and routes.csv.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - Benchmarks play an important role in pricing crude oil
data_type: benchmark definitions and qualitative crude classification
notes: Provides qualitative classifications (light/sweet, medium/sour) as text for Brent, WTI, Dubai and Oman. Its numeric API and sulfur values exist only inside a Bloomberg-sourced chart IMAGE and were deliberately NOT transcribed, which is why CG011-CG014 have null assay values.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - Strait of Hormuz remains critical oil chokepoint
notes: Most recent chokepoint flow figure in the dataset (Hormuz, 2024). Underlying tanker-tracking data is Vortexa, a COMMERCIAL provider, published through EIA - recorded per-row in flow_data_origin.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - Fewer tankers transit the Red Sea in 2024
notes: Source of the Bab el-Mandeb and Cape of Good Hope figures, both PARTIAL-year (January-August 2024) and both Vortexa-derived. The two movements are the same rerouting seen from two sides and must not be summed.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - Three important oil trade chokepoints around the Arabian Peninsula
notes: Source of the Suez Canal (Suez Canal Authority data) and SUMED figures. STALE: 2016 data. Refreshing these is a documented manual action.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - The Strait of Malacca links the Indian and Pacific Oceans
notes: Source of the Malacca figure. STALE: 2016 data. No newer text-readable Malacca volume was found.

source_name: EIA Today in Energy - Maritime chokepoints are critical to global energy security
notes: Source of the Turkish Straits description. NO flow volume was obtainable from it as text, which is why CP007's flow columns are null.

source_name: UN Security Council - Sanctions Committees
notes: Authority pointer only. The UN Consolidated List is not reproduced here.

source_name: EU Sanctions Map
notes: Authority pointer only. The EU Consolidated List is not reproduced here.

source_name: EIA Petroleum & Other Liquids spot price series
notes: Series DEFINITIONS only; no price values are stored anywhere in this repository. The companion WTI series is at https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/RWTCD.htm.

source_name: PPAC Prices - International Prices of Crude Oil (Indian Basket)
notes: Tier 1 Indian benchmark and the correct reference for India-specific price work. The underlying table is delivered by JavaScript, so frequency and series start could not be read as text and are null. The companion ICB Ratio series is at https://ppac.gov.in/prices/indian-crude-basket-icb-ratio.

source_name: EnergyShield-AI Phase 1 analyst-defined corridors
notes: NOT AN EXTERNAL SOURCE. The corridor topology is this project's own modelling, recorded at authority_level 'secondary' precisely so it can never be mistaken for sourced fact. Constituent nodes ARE sourced and are foreign keys into suppliers.csv, ports.csv and chokepoints.csv. Individual corridors carry separate corridor_evidence / corridor_evidence_url where external evidence exists; RT005 and RT008 have none.
